content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fishers

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma affects your required experience hours. Gather documentation of your project roles and responsibilities to verify you meet the threshold.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. You'll attend interactive sessions led by active certified practitioners covering the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement and prepares you directly for the certification exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the required examination fee through PMI's portal. PMI reviews and approves your application before you can schedule your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and instructor support, to reinforce your learning. Schedule your proctored exam through Pearson VUE. On exam day, demonstrate your mastery of project-management principles across all five PMBOK® domains to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification remains active for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) by completing training, leading projects, or contributing to the profession. Before expiration, renew your credential with PMI by submitting your PDUs and the renewal fee to stay current.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
